newsitem.title: GERMANY: Retailer Metro shares gain on H1 relief.
newsitem.headline: Retailer Metro shares gain on H1 relief.

text.p: Shares in Swiss-German retailer traded 2.20 marks higher at 138.20 on Thursday as analysts said its first-half results, while below original expectations, at least contained no shocks.
Metro earlier said first half group operating profits before goodwill rose to 181 million marks from 48 million.
"The orginal expectations were over 200 million marks but it's been in the market for some time now that they were due to be worse," one analyst that did not want to be named said.
Metro in August cut its 1996 sales forecast due to a change in prospects for overall economic growth.
The retailer on Thursday re-confirmed that it expected earnings from ordinary activities for the year as a whole to be around 1.1 billion marks.
